violation_type.title: Hand Sanitizer - Not Used on Visibly Soiled Hands Unless Away From Classroom and Soap & Water Not Available (26 TAC §746.3420(2))
violation_type.short_title: Hand Sanitizer - Not Used on Visibly Soiled Hands Unless Away From Classroom and Soap & Water Not Available
violation_type.typical_finding: Children were observed to be using hand sanitizer  instead of soap and water to wash hands before eating snack.

finding_variants.text: Children were observed to be using hand sanitizer  instead of soap and water to wash hands before eating snack.
The restrooms used by the children in care had hand sanitizers in them.  There was no hand soap. This was corrected at the inspection when the soap dispensers were placed in the restrooms.
The caregiver was observed giving the children hand sanitizer before having snack.    NOTE: This was corrected when the rest of the children were seen using the sink.
Based on the information provided by the caregiver, hand sanitizer was used to wash hands before lunch.    NOTE: This was corrected when the children were taken to the restroom down the hall.
The children in Toddler1 were given hand sanitizer before having lunch.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
Classroom is using hand sanitizer in replace of soap and water during diaper changing time.
